classification.notes: Article describes a Nasdaq rule change for halting/opening trading in ETPs during 23/5 trading hours. This is an exchange operational/procedural rule filing, not an outside market, regulatory, member, or infrastructure event that maps to any card in the catalog. The closest card might be ECS-SET-01 (extended trading hours) or XE-DISRUPT (exchange halt), but the article is about Nasdaq setting internal halt/open procedures for 23/5 sessions — it is a procedural rule amendment, not a new event triggering settlement cycle changes or a market disruption. No risk-relevant outside event is described.
